[[File:Christopher Kagehiro DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Christopher Kagehiro at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Christopher Kagehiro''' played in the Star Wars CCG Wild Card at [[DecipherCon 1999]] on 11 November 1999. After a Game 2 match he stood for a photograph with [[Stephanie Kagehiro]]. Decipher's caption named them "bro' and sis".<ref name="thu11">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000616102244/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/THU/thu11.html DecipherCon 1999 Thursday photo thu11], Decipher (Wayback 16 June 2000). Caption: "After their Game 2 match, bro' and sis Christopher and Stephanie Kagehiro stand tall before the Star Wars sign"</ref>
